Interface FastStatsContext.Builder

All Known Subinterfaces:
FastStatsContext.ConsentBuilder
All Known Implementing Classes:
SimpleContext.Builder, SimpleContext.ConsentBuilder
Enclosing interface:
FastStatsContext
public static sealed interface FastStatsContext.Builder permits SimpleContext.Builder, FastStatsContext.ConsentBuilder
Builder for FastStatsContext.

Platforms configure the platform-specific properties of the builder and delegate the service configuration to their users.

Since:
0.33.0

  • Method Details

    • token

      @Contract(value="_ -> this", mutates="this") FastStatsContext.Builder token(@Nullable String token)
      Sets the FastStats project token.

      If no token is set, the token injected at build time is read, if a token resource was configured. Without any token, the created context is disabled.

      Parameters:
      token - the FastStats project token, or null
      Returns:
      this builder
      Since:
      0.33.0

    • onReady

      @Contract(value="_ -> this", mutates="this") FastStatsContext.Builder onReady(Consumer<FastStatsContext> hook)
      Adds a hook that runs once when the context becomes ready.

      If a hook fails, the context stays not ready and all hooks run again on the next call, so hooks must be safe to run more than once.

      Parameters:
      hook - the hook
      Returns:
      this builder
      Since:
      0.33.0

    • onShutdown

      @Contract(value="_ -> this", mutates="this") FastStatsContext.Builder onShutdown(Consumer<FastStatsContext> hook)

      Returns:
      this builder

      0.33.0

    • service

      @Contract(value="_ -> this", mutates="this") FastStatsContext.Builder service(Function<SimpleContext, ? extends FastStatsService> service)
      Adds an optional service to the context.

      The factory receives the created context, so the service can use its logger, configuration, scheduler and submission helpers. Services are started before the metrics submission task and shut down before the metrics are flushed.

      Parameters:
      service - the service factory
      Returns:
      this builder
      Since:
      0.33.0

    • build

      @Contract(value=" -> new", mutates="io") FastStatsContext build() throws IllegalArgumentException, IllegalStateException, UncheckedIOException
      Builds the configured context.
      Returns:
      the configured context
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the token is invalid
      IllegalStateException - if a required property is missing or no service is configured
      UncheckedIOException - if an IO error occurs
